name: io.github.narcisbodea/smstunnel-mcp
title: SMSTunnel
description: Send texts (SMS) from your own Android phone and your own number, from any AI app.

environmentVariables.name: SMSTUNNEL_API_KEY
environmentVariables.description: Your SMSTunnel API key, from https://dashboard.smstunnel.io/apps (Apps → Add an app).

environmentVariables.name: SMSTUNNEL_DEVICE_ID
environmentVariables.description: Optional: the phone that sends when the assistant doesn't name one (its ID under Phones in the dashboard).

environmentVariables.name: SMSTUNNEL_DEFAULT_COUNTRY_CODE
environmentVariables.description: Optional: country calling code that completes numbers written without + or 00, e.g. +40.

environmentVariables.name: SMSTUNNEL_CONFIRM_EACH_TEXT
environmentVariables.description: Optional: true (default) makes AI apps that support it ask you before every text; false for unattended runs.
